toolsPreview.name: search_sec_filings
toolsPreview.description: SEC EDGAR filings processed with an LLM to extract supply chain signals, sentiment, and material mentions.

toolsPreview.name: search_restricted_entities
toolsPreview.description: US Consolidated Screening List. Use for supplier / counterparty due diligence against export-control and sanctions lists.

toolsPreview.name: get_trade_flows
toolsPreview.description: UN Comtrade annual export volumes by country and HS code for semiconductor-critical materials.

toolsPreview.name: get_quantum_funding
toolsPreview.description: US federal contracts and grants for quantum technology (DOE, NSF, DARPA/DoD, and others), from USAspending.gov. Shows which organizations receive quantum-related federal money, how much, and from which agency. Use to track the quantum supply chain and policy push downstream of the 2026 quantum executive orders.
